name: dod-guard-monorepo
description: MCP server plugins: dod-guard (anti-cheat DoD verification), obsidian-rag (RAG/memory on Obsidian vaults), evomcp (evolutionary solver with best-of-N + repair chains), and gitevo (evolutionary git branching for LLM agents)

plugins.name: dod-guard
plugins.description: Lock DoD proofs in MCP storage with anti-cheat verification. Ships 12 skills: /interview (structured requirements with adversarial spec review), /ratchet (multi-step problem solving with verification gates), /clean-house (hunt duplicate/obsolete implementations), /step-by-step (multi-step sequential execution with 5 specialized agents), /cheap-step (step-by-step with cheap-worker fanout), /adversarial-workflow (4-phase adversarial choreography - spec review, test audit, implementation review, structural gates), /test-integrity-checker (audit tests for LLM patterns where tests bless production bugs instead of catching them, with 1 specialized auditor agent), /blind-rewrite (delete then rebuild an implementation from a contract, for code or prose, with 5 specialized agents and an overlap gate that rejects paraphrase), /tighten (autonomous loop that removes accidental complexity one target per invocation, ranked by structural violations joined against git return-churn, with 2 specialized agents and a simplicity gate), /doc-reconcile (find documents that contradict each other, date each claim from its real edit history, and delete the older side when the dating is decisive, with 1 specialized judge agent), /skill-debug (debug a skill from the sessions that ran it, compacting each run into a numbered trace and aligning it against what the SKILL.md required), and /skill-migrate (migrate a SKILL.md, agent definition, CLAUDE.md, memory file, or instinct file to post-4.6 models by extracting a behavioral contract, classifying scaffolding against essential instructions, blind-rewriting the artifact, and gating on overlap, claim coverage, a gap audit, and a regression check, with 1 analyst agent).

plugins.name: obsidian-rag
plugins.description: RAG/memory MCP server on an Obsidian vault. Semantic search, note CRUD, memory recall, backlink traversal: all local, all offline. Ships the /rag-memory skill for vault search and cross-session memory workflows.

plugins.name: evomcp
plugins.description: Evolutionary solver MCP: cheap-model fanout with best-of-N + repair chains and scalar-fitness evolution, gated by dod-guard verification. Spawns claude -p (DeepSeek) instances with diverse strategies, verifies, repairs, escalates stuck nodes. Ships /cascade skill with 3 agents.

plugins.name: gitevo
plugins.description: Evolutionary git branching for LLM agents: checkpoint, spawn parallel exploration branches, learn from failures, merge winners, clean artifacts. evo_export_lessons bridges to obsidian-rag for persistent memory.

plugins.name: quality-guard
plugins.description: Structural code quality gate. A PostToolUse hook ratchets every write against a recorded baseline, so existing debt is allowed but making it worse is not. Ships 1 skill: /quality-refactor (systematic refactoring to an explicit machine-checked quality bar - one type per file, complexity and size bounds, dead-code removal - with a zero-dependency scanner and a ratcheting baseline).

plugins.name: natural-output-style
plugins.description: Output style only. Natural makes Claude write plain prose every turn - common words, short sentences, active voice, no filler and no marketing words. Keeps exact technical terms and explains them in plain words on the spot. It mirrors the rules ste-lint checks mechanically, so replies meet the same bar files do. Keeps Claude Code's built-in coding behavior. No MCP server, no skills, no hooks.
